name: DirtBound
description: A free browser rally game with generated stages, time challenges, multiplayer racing, and a circuit editor.

faq.question: Why did pressing R add 5 seconds?
faq.answer: R resets your car and adds five seconds to the stage time.

faq.question: I barely left the road. Why was my car reset?
faq.answer: If no wheel stays on the dirt for about three seconds, the game can reset the car and add five seconds. Falling off the route or getting stuck can also trigger a reset.

faq.question: Can my friend race the exact same random stage?
faq.answer: Yes. Copy the generated stage URL and send it to your friend so you can both try the same road.

faq.question: Where can I race against the record holder's ghost?
faq.answer: Try Circuit mode for timed laps and the record holder's ghost.

faq.question: Why is there no accelerator button on mobile?
faq.answer: On mobile, touch and drag to steer; the car accelerates automatically.

faq.question: Why do I need to sign in for multiplayer?
faq.answer: Solo stages work without an account. The official game uses Google sign-in for multiplayer lobbies, leaderboards, and circuit publishing.

faq.question: My game is stuttering. What should I change first?
faq.answer: Try the Low graphics preset in Settings to reduce scenery, shadows, and smoke on a slower device.

faq.question: Can I add trees or decorations to my custom track?
faq.answer: The editor supports creating and publishing circuits, but custom scenery placement was not verified during this content review.
